one_sentence_failure_summary: At step 16 the agent replaced -DXWINGRAPHX with -DSERVER despite having just read (step 15) the explicit Makefile comment stating -DSERVER disables the cdb debugger, and it never tested debugger functionality before claiming completion.
t_err_evidence: In step 16 the agent edits src/Makefile with: sed -i 's/-DXWINGRAPHX -DPERMUTATE -DRWLIMIT/-DSERVER/' — inserting -DSERVER, which the Makefile comments read at step 15 explicitly describe as '(1) -DSERVER 2 disables cdb debugger (koth server version)'.
t_commit_evidence: In step 21 the build succeeds with compiler flags '-O -DEXT94 -DSERVER -DPERMUTATE -DRWLIMIT', producing a binary with the debugger permanently disabled. The binary is then installed and used for the remainder of the trajectory.
trigger_explanation: At step 15, the agent read the src/Makefile and saw the comment clearly stating that -DSERVER 'disables cdb debugger (koth server version)'. Despite this visible disconfirming evidence, the agent chose -DSERVER at step 16 as a substitute for -DXWINGRAPHX, ignoring that this would eliminate the debugger which is a required feature.
forewarning_evidence: Step 15 Makefile contents show the comment: '# (1)   -DSERVER        2                   disables cdb debugger (koth server version)'. This explicitly warns that using -DSERVER will disable the debugger, but the agent proceeds to use it anyway at step 16.
